title: Every pass against the reference; packet versus model effect
question: How close is each pass to the reference, and does the packet-only input (pass P) lose anything once the model is held fixed (pass H)?
method: Reference against A, B, P (Haiku, packet only), H (Haiku, golden inputs); H against P; one manual value decision. Manual value decisions were appended on 2026-10-28 for the Sonnet comparisons; they decide only pairs that were pending, and these comparisons had none, so their scores are unaffected (input hash refreshed). I-R2 (2026-10-28): rerun with the instruments revised to D1 §6.2's token form for keys (ADR-0012); the nine keys of results/s0/manual_equivalence.tsv written in the old spelling (text-mode whitespace removed) were rewritten to the token form by code/i_r2_migrate_manual.py, no decision or reason changed.
commands: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/reference results/s0/stored/pass_a ref_vs_a
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/reference results/s0/stored/pass_b ref_vs_b
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/reference results/s0/stored/pass_p ref_vs_p
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/reference results/s0/stored/pass_h ref_vs_h
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/stored/pass_h results/s0/stored/pass_p h_vs_p --symmetric
conclusion: Haiku with full inputs (H) scores no better than Haiku with the packet only (P): the packet loses nothing measurable; the gap to the Opus passes is the model's. Rerun under the token form (I-R2): no figure changed.
